title: D2D industrial Internet of things federation learning system and method based on millimeter wave link
assignee: Nanjing Yunze Youxing Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Traditional machine learning data sets are concentrated for training, which is not feasible in real-life scenarios due to privacy and security concerns, as well as the need for timely processing in the industrial IoT environment where data is distributed across various locations. Millimeter wave federated learning model transmission still has limitations in terms of device access and energy consumption.
pse.solution_function: The system performs decentralized training of a federated learning model, protecting data privacy while utilizing advantages from all parties to improve the accuracy and generalization ability of the model. It also implements efficient communication and edge aggregation within the industrial IoT based on millimeter wave links. Key functionality includes establishing D2D connections with non-LOS devices using appropriate LOS devices as relays for model relay propagation, reducing processing and transmission delays, and reducing energy consumption.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a central server, multiple edge platforms, and multiple devices. Edge platform set is utilized for efficient communication and edge aggregation in the industrial IoT.
pse.solution_implementation: During operation, appropriate LOS devices establish D2D connections with non-LOS devices for model relay propagation. This process takes into account millimeter wave link propagation loss and utilizes idle waiting time after LOS device model transmission is completed.
pse.effect: The system provides a measurable benefit by improving response speed, real-time performance, industrial production efficiency, and quality in the industrial IoT environment. It also reduces energy consumption and ensures efficient connections and transmissions between systems.
